[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`[N` / `]N` (and `[{` / `]}` after any `n` walk) open the first [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]note of the previous / next group on every canonical daily, week, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and quarter note, on records of albums that set `walk_by`, and on [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]any note whose nav line carries `«` / `»` links. `\[n` / `]n` walk a[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]grouped album one group at a time. The property card's docked rail [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and the links walker footer show the same group stops, and a stop [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]whose note does not exist yet looks clearly, calmly different from [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one that will never be created.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]links on link-only nav lines, build the one resolver (authored, then the[/#D7D7AF]
